input.subject: Samsung Odyssey G6 Dual
input.body: Dear Team, I want to get the Samsung Odyssey OLED G6 for use with both my PS5 and gaming PC. Is it possible to connect both devices and switch between them?

args.query: What is ByteMart's policy on product compatibility and connection for gaming devices?

resolver.draft: Hi Ravi Saxena, thank you for your inquiry about the Samsung Odyssey OLED G6. Yes, it is possible to connect both your PS5 and gaming PC to the monitor and switch between them. The monitor typically has multiple input ports, allowing you to connect different devices simultaneously. Please refer to the product specifications for details on the available ports and compatibility. If you have any further questions, feel free to ask!
